title: Eclipse Tobacco Sorceress
description: A hooded, spectral female figure stands centered with glowing circular eyes, her body replaced by a tall flowering tobacco plant with large green leaves and yellow blossoms rising from the ground through her torso. She is set against a dramatic sky featuring a large black solar eclipse surrounded by a fiery orange corona, with swirling purple smoke and dark silhouetted trees framing the scene.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a hooded spectral female figure with glowing circular eyes, her body merging into a tall flowering tobacco plant with large green leaves and yellow flower spikes growing from the ground up through her torso. She stands in swirling purple smoke with arms outstretched, set against a dramatic twilight sky with a large black solar eclipse ringed in bright orange fire, dark gnarled trees with hanging moss framing the composition, mystical and eerie atmosphere.
